description: The VM's SERIAL CONSOLE: kernel messages and early-boot/cloud-init output. ⛔ THIS IS NOT YOUR APPLICATION'S LOGS. For a deployed app - a crash loop, a 500, a failed DB connection - use get_container_logs, which returns what the containers actually printed. Reach for this one only for boot-level questions: the machine never came up, the disk did not mount, cloud-init failed before the app existed. Note that on this platform the console goes silent once a machine is past early boot, so an empty result here says nothing about a running VM.

instance_id.description: ID of the instance to fetch BOOT/console logs for. For app logs use get_container_logs instead.

name: get_instance_logs
title: Get instance logs
